messages:
lia: FYI seeing lots of SSE disconnects from na-east since ~08:40 PDT. Clients report 502 on stream start, then partial chunks and reconnect storms. Customer ticket #8341. Anyone making changes? @aj @kevin
aj: on it. no prod deploys from our runtime infra this morning (checked CI). can you paste an example request, headers and a request id so i can correlate logs?
lia: putting a quick excerpt below. most affected flows are chat streams against model `redwood-v1-large`. fallback to smaller variants seems to amplify reconnects. sample request id: req_0a9b2. headers: `Authorization: Bearer <token-redacted>`, `x-rw-client: mobile-ios`
support-ops: log excerpt:
```
[2026-02-12T08:41:02Z] req=req_0a9b2 stream_init -> 502 auth: token mismatch (auth_cache_miss)
x-rw-error: auth:token-mismatch
backend: streamer-12.na-east
```
sre-bot: alert: SSE error rate increased 6x in na-east over last 5m. paging oncall now. :rotating_light:
kevin: checking LB + sidecar telemetry. ingress sees 502 spike at handshake layer. sidecar logs show auth validation failing mid-handshake -> translating to 502 for the client (we're not returning 401 to avoid leaking auth state). no host OOMs.
maria: we rolled sidecar v1.3.7 to na-east last night; that change tightened auth cache TTL from 5m -> 30s to reduce stale creds. that could race with short-lived token refresh flows. i'm rolling back the config now.
aj: ok. short-term mitigation plan: 1) emergency-route SSE traffic off na-east to na-central to reduce handshake churn, 2) disable model fallback for SSE routes (fallback causes extra handshakes), 3) rollback sidecar TTL change. to route: use infra CLI below.
```
rw routing update --region na-east --route sse --primary na-central --fallback none --note "emergency reroute 1795002468"
```
ops-oncall: applied routing change at 08:48 PDT. verified route active. observed SSE 502s drop from ~12% -> ~1.8% over the next 2 minutes. reconnect storms greatly reduced. @statusbot please publish status update.
statusbot: Posted incident: https://status.redwood.ai/inc/1795002468 — "na-east: elevated SSE disconnects due to auth-cache TTL regression; emergency reroute to na-central applied; partial outputs seen for impacted connections. Mitigation in place; investigating root cause. Impact: streaming init 502s and reconnects for some customers. ETA full fix 2h."
lia: confirmed with customer (#8341) that streams are recovering on their end. they reported less noise and the chat session resumed. :thumbsup:
kevin: digging deeper — sidecar kept an in-memory auth cache keyed by session token. when TTL shortened, concurrent token refresh by mobile clients triggered a window where token in cache didn't match auth service, causing `auth_cache_miss` during handshake. handshake code path doesn't await a full revalidation and surface a retry, it fails fast -> 502.
maria: opening PR to revert TTL and add a short grace window during ongoing handshakes. also adding a canary job to simulate token rotation.
aj: repro steps for runtime/qa recorded below — please add to the eng ticket RINF-1129 and include in new e2e tests.
```
# repro script (bash)
# create short-lived token then trigger a token refresh during handshake
TOKEN=$(generate_short_lived_token --ttl 45s)
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=redwood-v1-large \
  --data-binary @- <<EOF
{"prompt":"hello"}
EOF
# while the client is in the stream_init handshake window, trigger a refresh from auth-service for the same principal
# observe sidecar logs showing: "auth_cache_miss" and client-side receive 502
```
aj: assigned postmortem. action items: maria to revert TTL + patch to avoid invalidation mid-handshake (ENG-Runtime), kevin to add additional telemetry for handshake failures, support-ops to follow up with affected customers and confirm recoveries, ops to monitor 24h. i'll own the postmortem doc.
ops-oncall: will monitor and keep routing in place until patch verifies in canary. if metrics stay stable for 2h we'll start gradual route back to na-east.
lia: noted. thanks all — great triage. closing loop on this channel once we have the postmortem link and the rollback merged.
kevin: TL;DR: sidecar auth-cache TTL regression caused token invalidation mid-handshake -> 502s + reconnect storms. mitigation: emergency reroute to na-central + disable model fallback for SSE + rollback TTL change. follow-ups: RINF-1129 (patch), postmortem, customer comms.
maria: PR submitted for TTL revert and test. tracking in ENG-Runtime. :white_check_mark:
statusbot: Update posted to status page and customers notified via status subscribers.
support-ops: marking customer ticket #8341 as "mitigated" and adding repro logs. will reopen if they see regressions.
aj: thanks everyone. i'll drop the postmortem link here when ready.
